The results of a cross-country team's training run are graphed below. Which student has the greatest average speed?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image is a distance-time coordinate graph, with the horizontal axis labeled time, the vertical axis labeled distance, and the origin O at the lower left. In the graph there are points corresponding to five students: Evelyn's point is located relatively far to the left and relatively high; Carla's point is also high but has a clearly larger time value; Debra's point is at a medium distance and relatively far to the right; Briana's point is lower and has a small to medium time; Angela's point is very far to the right and has a low distance. Reasoning: Average speed equals distance/time, which on a distance-time graph is the slope of the line from the origin to that point. Comparing the slopes of the points relative to the origin, Evelyn's point reaches a very large distance in a very small time, so the slope from the origin to Evelyn is the greatest. Although Carla's distance is high, her time is also larger; the slopes of Debra, Briana, and Angela are all smaller. So the one with the greatest average speed is Evelyn.

raw_record.question_text: According to the graph, which student has the greatest average speed?

method.method_draft: Read the distance-time coordinate graph: identify each labeled point for Evelyn, Carla, Debra, Briana, and Angela, using horizontal position as time and vertical position as distance. For each student, compare average speed as distance divided by time, which is the slope of the line from the origin O to that student's point. The point with the steepest origin-to-point slope represents the greatest average speed. Evelyn’s point is farthest upward relative to its small time value, giving the largest distance/time ratio, so the answer is Evelyn.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图是一个距离-时间坐标图，横轴标为 time，纵轴标为 distance，原点 O 在左下方。图中有五个学生对应的点：Evelyn 的点位于较靠左且较高的位置；Carla 的点也较高但时间值明显更大；Debra 的点在中等距离且较靠右；Briana 的点较低且时间较小到中等；Angela 的点很靠右且距离较低。推理：平均速度等于 distance/time，在距离-时间图上就是从原点到该点连线的斜率。比较各点相对于原点的斜率，Evelyn 的点在很小的时间内达到很大的距离，因此原点到 Evelyn 的斜率最大。Carla 虽然距离高，但时间也更大；Debra、Briana、Angela 的斜率都更小。所以平均速度最大的是 Evelyn。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct graph-interpretation route using slope from the origin on a distance-time graph; it is the primary and likely only genuinely distinct method for this problem.
planner_metadata.image_role: The image provides the plotted distance-time graph, the origin O, axis meanings, and the labeled student points. The solver reads each student's relative time and distance from the graph and compares their slopes from the origin.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text asks which student has the greatest average speed, indicating that the desired output is one student's name and that the comparison should be made from the graph.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the rule average speed = distance ÷ time. On a distance-versus-time graph, this equals the slope of the ray from the origin to the plotted point; the greatest speed corresponds to the steepest such ray.
